title: Understanding Pruning
text: Pruning a decision tree involves removing branches that have little importance. Think about how this might affect the tree's complexity and its ability to adapt to different datasets.

title: Variance in Decision Trees
text: Consider how a simpler model, with fewer branches, might respond to variations in the data. Would it be more or less sensitive to changes?

title: Effect of Pruning on Variance
text: What happens to the variance of a decision tree when it is pruned?
